title: Upper Lower ROD 1.61
author: Rodrigo C.
desc:
The purpose of the program is to achieve a physique similar to Guts producing using as base the Guts training problem by Natural Hypertrophy.
Version: 1.61

ss.note:

Ring Dip - 2-3 sets, 8-15 reps

Dumbbell Row 8-12 reps 2-4 sets, or 20 to 6 reps in 6 weeks.

2-4- 10-15

side bends 2-4 sets 8-15 reps.
